neighbours.label: a physical sensation from exercise: feeling a stretch or a burn, muscle soreness
fire: Straighten your leg and lean toward your toes. You should feel a mild stretch along your hamstring.
After ten squats I could really feel the burn in my legs.
Beginners often get muscle soreness after a hard session.
Hold the plank until you feel a burn in your core.
Roll your shoulders back and feel the stretch across your chest.
The next morning my calves were sore from the sprints.
You may feel a slight pull in your lower back during this pose.
Doing too many lunges will leave your thighs aching.
quiet: Straighten your desk and clean up your papers. You should see a clear space along your wall.
After ten minutes I could really hear the rain on the roof.
Beginners often get helpful tips after a first session.
Hold the door until you see a car in the drive.
Roll your sleeves up and wash the dishes in the sink.
The next morning my parents were gone from the house.
You may hear a slight noise in the lower hall during this play.
Doing too many errands will leave your weekend empty.

notes: The card's output direction: the + pole suppresses ' workout', ' sensation', ' plank', ' muscle', ' exercises', so this - pole promotes them.
